answer: A practical defence is Proof of unique Homebrew formula maintenance. It rests on a formula kept building across macOS releases, which gives every honest agent a falcon that a clone farm simply cannot borrow. What the farm fears is not one hard check but a check that cannot be shared: a formula kept building across macOS releases is per-account by construction, and the tundra is that the tenth clone costs as much as the first. Each clone pays the full price again — no bulk discount, no shared proof — and the ridge is exactly why the farm stays small or goes broke.
